kick.ban.description: Bans a viewer from your Kick chat for good. Fails when you are not signed in to Kick or the user cannot be found.

parameters.user: The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42".
parameters.reason: Optional. Why they were banned, like "Spam".

kick.deleteMessage.description: Deletes one message from your Kick chat. Fails when the message id is empty.

parameters.messageId: The id of the chat message, like the %messageId% of a chat trigger.

kick.getBroadcaster.description: Gives you the details of your Kick account and bot account as Cuebot knows them right now. Values are empty when you are not signed in.
kick.getBroadcaster.returns: An object with broadcastUser, broadcastUserId, broadcasterChannelSlug, broadcasterIsLive, broadcasterTitle, broadcasterCategory, broadcasterViewerCount, botUser and botUserId.

kick.getUserInfo.description: Looks up a Kick viewer's profile and channel. Fails when the user cannot be found.

parameters.user: The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42".

kick.getUserInfo.returns: An object with User, UserName, UserId, ProfilePicture, ChannelSlug, IsLive, StreamTitle, Category and Description.

kick.reply.description: Replies to a message in your Kick chat. Long text is split into several messages; only the first one is the reply.

parameters.message: What to say, like "Thanks for asking!"
parameters.replyTo: The id of the message to answer, like the %messageId% of a chat trigger.
parameters.useBot: Optional. true sends it with your bot account. Leave it out to send as yourself.
parameters.fallback: Optional. With useBot, true (the default) sends as yourself when the bot is not signed in; false makes it fail instead.

kick.reply.returns: The id of the message that was sent last, or null when the message was empty.

kick.sendMessage.description: Sends a message in your Kick chat. Long text is split into several messages. Fails when you are not signed in to Kick.

parameters.message: What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!"
parameters.useBot: Optional. true sends it with your bot account. Leave it out to send as yourself.
parameters.fallback: Optional. With useBot, true (the default) sends as yourself when the bot is not signed in; false makes it fail instead.

kick.sendMessage.returns: The id of the message that was sent last, or null when the message was empty.

kick.setCategory.description: Changes the category of your Kick stream. A name picks the exact match, or else the first search result. Fails when nothing matches.

parameters.category: The category name, like "Just Chatting", or its number id.

kick.setCategory.returns: The name of the category that was set.

kick.setTitle.description: Changes the title of your Kick stream. Fails when the title is empty.

parameters.title: The new title, like "Chill games with chat".

kick.timeout.description: Times out a viewer in your Kick chat. Kick counts in whole minutes, so seconds are rounded up (1 minute to 7 days).

parameters.user: The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42".
parameters.seconds: Optional. How long, in seconds, like 300. Leave it out for 300 (5 minutes).
parameters.reason: Optional. Why they were timed out, like "Calm down".

kick.unban.description: Lets a banned or timed-out viewer chat on Kick again.

parameters.user: The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42".
